Panels that reverse the page

The page follows the reader's color scheme. Two panels below force a scheme of their own, one dark and one light, so each capture shows one panel that matches the page and one that reverses it.

Dark panel

This panel always uses the dark tokens. It has a link, a field and a button of its own.

Light panel

Colors here come from the light tokens, whatever the page around it uses. A link in the panel and some inline code should read clearly against this background.

The panel should still feel like part of one page.

Dark inside a light panel

A deeper level goes back to dark. Scopes should nest as deep as the markup does.

Back in the page

Content after the panels returns to the page theme. A link in the page and a highlighted phrase sit here.
